summary: Verified pagination testids on role desks + WMS Stok, and that status tabs in Cuti/Kontrabon/Kasus Keuangan render a count on EVERY tab (not just the active one). Backend status-counts/stats endpoints are correct and sum-to-total; frontend testids are all wired. All checks passed — no issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: RoleDesk.jsx (line 79) uses usePagedRows(queues, { pageSize: 8, testId: `${p}-queues-pager` }) — pager renders only when rows.length > pageSize, matching the spec; prefix per desk (my-desk / md-desk / wh-desk).
SalesAdminDesk.jsx (line 85) uses testId: 'desk-queues-pager' with pageSize 8 — same semantic.
BalancesTable.jsx uses PagedRows with testId 'balances-table-pager' (25 rows/page); verified live: pager + prev/next render with 25 balance-row-* items on page 1.

LeaveView.jsx fetches /api/hr/leave-requests/status-counts and passes countOf={(v) => (v ? statusCounts[v]||0 : statusCounts.total ?? rows.length)} to OptionTabs — all 5 status options show their own count regardless of active filter.
ContraBonsView.jsx fetches /api/contra-bons/status-counts and renders 9 cb-filter-status-* options each with their numeric count.
FinanceCasesView.jsx uses stats.by_status for per-tab counts; stats.total for 'Semua'; backend finance_case_service.stats returns by_status (dict) + total — sum matches total.
seed_data_creation: Dynamic pytest TestLeaveCountsDynamic creates 2 TEST_iter158 hr_leave_requests, approves one & rejects the other, verifies counts, then deletes them directly from Mongo in test teardown (no public DELETE endpoint). Verified 0 leftover rows after run.
